text:
tess: quick heads-up: proposing an RBAC change so the new event-relay svcacct can read keystore event-metadata. this touches KMS audit and our SAST/DAST gates — need a fast review.
omar: what's the least-privilege set? only read metadata, no crypto ops, right? :thinking_face:
tess: correct. propose role `keystore.eventViewer` with only `events.read` and attribute filter `resource.env=canary`. token TTL 48h.
olivia: SAST flagged a serializer that may accidentally include env-derived bytes. scan id S-3344. link in PR required. we should not widen RBAC until we confirm redaction.
security-bot: SAST alert: rule 'unsafe-serialization' in repo redwood/event-relay at relay/serialize.go:64. https://scans.internal/S-3344
omar: can we do a canary with audit-only mode (no downstream export) to validate logs before granting consumer binding?
tess: yes — canary plan:
  - stage A: deploy relay with `EXPORT_DISABLED=true` and RBAC binding but audit-only tag set.
  - stage B: run audit smoke queries for 30m traffic; if clean, flip export flag in canary region.
  - stage C: if no findings in 60m, proceed to patch serializer and mandatory pre-merge SAST check.

olivia: audit query I recommend (GCP):

gcloud logging read "resource.type=gae_app AND jsonPayload.stream=\"keystore-events\" AND resource.labels.env=\"canary\"" --limit 500 --project=redwood-canary | jq -r '.jsonPayload|@json' | grep -E "(secret|password|private_key|AWS_SECRET)"

omar: include KMS audit check for key access: 

gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName: \"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND resource.labels.project_id=\"redwood-canary\"" --limit 100

devex: I'll add a pre-merge pipeline template change: SAST must pass or be accompanied by a PR-level mitigation and unit tests proving redaction. suppression requests must use the standard form and link to test artifacts.

oncall: rollback play if leak detected: 1) remove svcacct binding, 2) scale relay to 0, 3) open INC-4820, 4) export last 2k events to secure blob for forensic. owners: @omar (rollback exec) and @tess (postmortem).

tess: also adding a small binary DAST probe in staging that fires synthetic payloads and asserts none of the secrets regexes appear in emitted events. DAST probe will run after serializer patch.

olivia: for SAST suppression policy: we only allow temporary suppression when code changes in the same PR fully mitigate the pattern and unit + e2e tests are present. I'll sign off suppression reviews.

security-bot: Note: attach KMS audit export and audit-smoke output to the PR. KMS audit log retention: 90 days.

omar: rolling canary now with audit-only. i'll post snippets in 20m.
tess: thanks — checklist for PR reviewers: 1) RBAC diff minimal and attribute filter present; 2) audit-smoke output attached; 3) unit/e2e redaction tests; 4) DAST probe added to staging pipeline.

devex: ETA for pipeline change: today EOW. will add comment template for suppression requests and automate the audit log attachment step.

oncall: added INC-4820 to pager rotation. monitoring dashboards to watch: keystore-event-errors, audit-exceptions, ksm-decrypt-failures. :lock:

other followups: olivia to review SAST suppression, devex to update pipeline, omar to run canary + query, tess to open runbook link in PR.
